title: Oral and Perioral Herpes Simplex Virus Infection Type I in a Five-month-old Infant: A Case Report
brief_summary: A five-month-old healthy girl who presented with painful herpetic gingivostomatitis and perioral vesicles.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Five-months-old infants or younger

Exclusion Criteria:

* Six-months-old infants or older
study_population: This is a case report study
